notes.title: Progress Update #17 - 5 Months... Again.
notes.notes:
Hello there Steam Community and everyone participating in it!

It has been... A long time, actually. Again. I feel like this has ( sadly ) become a standard thing to open up a post here for me, which sucks. I know I apologized for it a thousand times by now already, but I still want to apologize for not keeping you guys up to date.

The thing is... There is not really much to report regarding My New Memories at the moment. After I released the sequel on January 1st and, thanks to that, had a good start into the new year, the "old" despair settled in again because my assets are still in the hands of the german law enforcement, also known as the cops ( or Polizei, in German ).

I did not get any news from my lawyer yet and I'm honestly at a loss for words by now. How can it be that 1 1/2 years have passed and I literally never got an answer to my request to hand out the harddrive that only contains my rendering assets for My New Memories? Why does a single police woman have the power to keep it because she deems some of the characters are inappropiate, even though they're not even sexualized in any shape or form? And even better ( I wasn't supposed to share this but I guess I will now anyway ), she literally complained about characters like Lena and Sabrina looking inappropiate. One person has the power to say "No, I don't think they look appropiate enough, I'll keep his shit until a court hearing has happened". Welcome to Germany, I guess...

Anyway, I did not want to make this post to just cry and be bitter. I actually have some news regarding Chapter 4 that might either excite you or make you say "What are you smoking?"

You amazing people probably know that I'm an active user in different communities and in one of those forums, a person mentioned that I could release kind of a "snippet" for Chapter 4 to refresh peoples memories of what's going on in the game right now. Since I have the assets for Sabrina and Bethany I gave this a thought and really, really liked the idea. So I'm doing exactly that. I'm currently working ( and have been since the release of the first prequel chapter ) on an update that will release (hopefully) sometimes this month!

This update will not be Chapter 4 but rather... Chapter 3.5 ? No, that's also not correct. Basically, you download the update and load your savegame and the game will tell you what you are about to play now - A very very very small portion ( one long event ) with Sabrina that happens at the first ingame day of Chapter 4. In this event you will talk with Sabrina about the events of the night before ( the Mike incident, if you want to call it that ) and a lot of other things that have happened during the day ( Anna is awake, you finally see Karla and the ginger twins and you have the extremely important discussion with Jessica during the day ). During this event you will also experience a kind of "flashback" with Sabrina, where they will talk about their first intimate encounter. If you played the prequel you can maybe guess what I'm going to do there. This whole snippet will be around ~20 to 30 minutes of playtime, depending on your reading speed.

And before anyone mentions this, no, I'm not doing this because of the new change Steam made. I had this idea before Steam showed that some games didn't update for a long time. That's why I'm also considering only releasing this on the beta branch, so you're not forced to give it a go or anything like that. I'm honing the current situation and accept that Steam has to put this notice down on Early Access games. The fact is that the last update has been in May 2023 and there is no way I'm going to "trick" players to think that this little snippet will be more than it is.

Anyway, I have written quite a lot of stuff again now and the most important part is coming up. What do you guys think about this idea? You can give me an honest and direct answer, if you hate it or love it, I'm open to hear any feedback you have. I personally thought it was a good idea just to remind you amazing people what is currently going on in the game and to maybe excite you even more for the upcoming release of Chapter 4 - which will come faster than you might think, once I Have my rendering assets back.

Feel free to share your feedback in the comments or in the Steam discussion forum! I will post a few renders before I have the snippet ready, so stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Progress Update #15 - It has been a while...
notes.notes:
Hello there Steam people!

It has been...Well, a too long time since I last posted about my situation and what is going on in general. I'm really sorry about that, but the month of August is a pretty "traumatic" one for me, especially this time because I had to do things that were very, very uncomfortable.

Let me talk about this first, if you don't want to read stuff that is about my personal life, just skip this section and jump to the next paragraph. Anyway, as most of you probably know, my equipment has been seized by the police exactly one year ago. While the initial allegations are basically non existant anymore, the investigating police officer seems to have an issue with my game(s), or rather, the characters portrayed in it. This lead to me having to go to the police station so that my finger prints and pictures can be taken. This has been... Well, extremely hard, because I felt like I was being treated like a fucking criminal, a predator and a piece of shit. At the moment there is only one person basically ruining my whole life, and that is the investigating police officer who is trying her best to portray me as some kind of monster - Mainly because she can't get ahold of the main suspect that also framed/blackmailed me, since he is still in Thailand. His friends got sentenced to long jail sentences but he is still gone, so I think that she wants to get "some kind of win". And the fact that I'm making these games ( and that they make a decent amount of money as well ) probably is not something she likes. I don't know what this will lead to, Adult Visual Novels are banned from the German Steam store anyway, but it's not like my games are hard to find or hidden in some darknet tor node. You can find them everywhere on the internet on so many sites so...Yeah. I really don't see why she would have such issues with what I do for a living. But oh well... This has been pretty bad but I'm starting to get over it day by day. The fact that they are still taking their sweet ass time to process everything ( how difficult can it be for a state attorney to check if my render assets really contain something illegal so we can get to a judge so that they can decide ) shows you how awful the german law enforcement is. Waiting times that go beyond 1 year are pretty normal, especially when things are involved like this. Oh well...That is all regarding that.

Let's talk about the games now, I guess.

During these last two months I continued to work on both games, My New Memories Chapter 4 and My New Memories: The beginning. A playable demo for The Beginning will be released soon and you can grab it from the Steam page as soon as it's out - Just give me a little bit more time. The release of the prequel is also sooner than you might think, because I'm about 80% done with the first "chapter" That I'm going to put out. The initial plan for the prequel was to just have it as a short game that serves as a bridge to the main game, as you know. But given the fact that we still don't know when I get my stuff back, I decided to make it a little deeper and fill it with more content. I think this is something everyone can look forward to and once I Have my stuff back, I can simply add the "ending" to the prequel and continue to work full time on the main game.

Speaking about the main game, the script of Chapter 4 is getting bigger and bigger. I now reached a point where it should be around the size of Chapter 3 and the initial release combined, maybe a little less. Since Anna woke up I can do so many things that I wanted to do since the beginning, so I can add so many more events than I initially had in mind when I worked on the game in general. Anna waking up is a key moment, as you all know, but there are also other moments that will be super important going down the road in Chapter 4. There will be lots ( and I mean lots ) of funny and lewd moments, like the sauna with Lina or the date with Yukiko. The family will grow, as some of you may remember, so that is also something you can look forward too - 3 Big breasted gingers.

The thing is...There is not really much else to talk about, sadly. My life is basically working on the prequel and while the renders for the prequel are being made, write more for Chapter 4. It's...Pretty depressing, to be honest. I used to be full of energy and enthusiasm after an update dropped, and I still kinda am, but it's nothing compared to how I used to be back in the day. I really hope that once I have my render assets back I can get back to my old "strength".

One last thing before I leave you guys with a few renders from the prequel. It's totally fine if you think I'm making this all up, that I just want to do this and that. But please, don't try to force this opinion and view onto other people. Just like I can't force you to believe the things I said, you should not force anyone else to think like you do. If you think I'm a liar and a scammer, that's fine. You can block/ignore me and move on and find games you might enjoy more and deves that don't disappoint you. Just...I dont know. Maybe being a little more mindful with personal insults and calling me names could help.

notes.title: Progress Update #14 - There are some news!
notes.notes:
Hello there Steam people!

Can't believe it has been such a long time again...But a lot has happened recently and while some news are good, others are kinda neutral. No bad news so far though, so I guess that is good, right?

First, the Steam page for the prequel is currently being checked by valve. The weekend is inbetween, so I expect that it will be approved tomorrow ( Monday, the 27th ). Then you will be able to wishlist the game and get all the info you need. I also put a little #faq there where I explain why the prequel exists and what my plans going forward.

So the good news is that the court case where I was the victim is done now. The four culprits that are there ( since the main culprit fled to thailand ) got sentenced to quite decently long jail times - The highest was six years and ten months. The chances that the main culprit decides to come back to Germany on his own are basically zero now, but according to the german press there is a chance that interpol might get involved ( not just because of the case where I'm the victim, the dude did horrible things before that ).

The more neutral news is that there are still no real news regarding my confiscated equipment. There are some things that I learned that I'm not allowed to share publicly yet, mainly because it involves the case files that I only am supposed to talk about with my lawyer. One thing I can say is though that yes, this game will also be reviewed by the german law enforcement. Since the game is super public and available on Steam and in the normal internet in general, I have zero doubts that this will end positively for me, though. I have all the rights on my side. But I might have to rally some of you amazing people to speak out your support for this game if it comes to that.

Now before I talk about Chapter 4, I want to address a few things that have happened recently. I know that I should not pay attention to these people but I feel like just letting their comments stand in the room without saying anything to is is also wrong. No, I'm not working on the prequel for a quick cash grab. No, I'm not working on the prequel because I lost my character files or anything like that. No, I'm not working on the prequel because I have no idea where to go with the Story etc, quite the opposite actually. The only reason I even started to work on the prequel is so I can keep improving my rendering and writing skills. I could have made a completely new game with a different name etc, but I'm always trying to be as transparent as possible, even if it means telling you people about details that are rather private. Trust me on this, though. There is not a single person out in this world that is more angry about the fact I can't work on the main game right now than me.

Okay, now let's talk a little about Chapter 4. Obviously my work is more on the prequel right now, but while the images for that are rendering I always find the time to continue work on Chapter 4. With Anna being awake my brain is basically flooded with new events and things I want to do in the game. Not only that, the addition with Karla, Caroline and Emily opened up so many possibilities for me. The hot step mom, the cute half sisters...The options are pretty big. Then there is the situation with Sarah that needs addressing, Jessica who went missing because of anger the MC is not at fault for. My mind is still there, even though I'm going through some horrible shit right now, but my creativity never has been stronger, I feel like.

And a big part of that is also the fact that I'm working on the prequel. The girls you meet there ( I decided that all of them will appear in the main game at some point ) can be integrated so well into the main story. A lot of the things the MC experienced regarding his work life can also be explained with things that happened in the prequel. The fact that I can tie them together this well and that people who never played the main game will still have fun with the prequel makes me happy. This and the fact that so many of you amazing people have my back are the things that keep me sane. Because I was in a very dark place again around two weeks ago, when I had a call with my lawyer. Now thinks are looking better again and I'm never going to give up.

To end this very long post I'll give you guys a few more teasers from the prequel. As soon as the prequel page is live I will make another announcement, like I said. There is also going to be a trailer. Sorry about the delay on this, I completely forgot how much you have to do to set up a Steam page.

notes.title: Progress Update #13 - Prequel and other things!
notes.notes:
Hello there you amazing Steam people!

It has been over a month already since I shared what's going on with you so I feel like now is a good time for an update. I will start with some personal stuff which has been happening these last few weeks and then I'll update you on the current status of the game and the concrete plans for the prequel going forward.

Last week I had my hearing as witness/side plantiff regarding a case that lead to one of the suspects ( the main suspect, actually ) to frame me to the german Police which ultimately lead to them confiscating all my hardware and harddrives. Now here comes the interesting part: The Main witness fled to thailand. I'm not joking and this is not a prank, one day before the court case was opened ( 19th March ) he messaged the court and told them he fled to thailand - Because he is afraid to testify in court because of his friends. Him and his friends mugged and robbed me back in August 2023 which led, like I said above, to this guy accusing me of horrible things and using faked evidence ( my lawyer tried to explain so many times that everyone can fake WhatsApp or Telegram chats ). Since all but one suspect were released again ( after they got arrested by the SEK, which is like the german version of the S.W.A.T. ), it was apparently pretty easy for him to flee. He now has an international arrest warrant open and while my lawyer thinks he will eventually come back, I doubt it. Anyway, this doesn't matter too much since his four friends were still there when I had to testify. This was probably the second hardest day of my life ( only getting beat by being raided by the cops ), but I'm glad this part is "over" now. The fact that the main suspect ( and main accuser in the case against me ) fled to thailand is positive, though, which hopefully the state attorney will also see eventually. The end of the current court case is set to the end of may - It could be earlier ( or later ) as well, though. Since the main suspect is not here it should be faster, though. Fingers crossed for that at least. The questioning in court lasted around 2 1/2 hours and the judge, state attorney and most of the lawyers were okay as well ( just 2 exceptions for the lawyers who asked questions where even the judge rolled with her eyes ).

Okay, that was a lot of stuff that didn't have anything to do with the game, but I feel like you guys still deserve to know what's going on and why I'm sometimes more "silent" for a longer period of time.

While I was silent I was working a lot, though. Not only on Chapter 4 but also on My New Memories: The Beginning, which is going to be the prequel for My New Memories.

If you are not familiar with why I'm making a prequel, it's basically to "kill time" and keep my rendering skills fresh while also doing something for My New Memories. The prequel will play around 20 years before the main game, before the MC and Anna reuinited and will feature Sabrina and Bethany from the main game.

So, the prequel. I made great progress on it and the first day is already fully playable. I read through all of your comments that said I should not make it free and just ask a small price for it - Which is probably what I will have to end up doing anyway. My initial plan was to make the prequel free so people can get a intro and then maybe decide to buy the main game. But with upcoming legal fees and other things, I might have to ask for a small price for it, like 3.99 or 4.99. I'm not 100% sure on this yet and this is still all subject to change, I will probably know for a fact once I'm getting closer to the release of it - Which should be sooner than later! I hope this is okay for you guys and if you have any thoughts about this, feel free to share them here in the comments or in the discussion section of the main game. As soon as I have the Steam page up I will also explain there why I'm making a prequel and why I can't work on the main game right now. Wishlisting helps a lot so I'll let you guys know as soon as I have something to show!

I already showed you the girls of the prequel and explained what it will be mostly about. While the MC and Anna are soulmates in the main game, the MC still gathered some experience before him and Anna became a couple again. Anna had all her first times with the MC, but the MC already got some experience with other girls before that. And not only that, he was also introduced to some rather...Interesting kinks with them. The only thing I changed from my previous news post is that the game won't play in college but in a university now. I know that there is not a big difference if you are from the USA, but this will make it 100% certain for steam staff that the game only features adult characters, not high schoolers or anything like that. You will get to experience the backstory of five girls you will eventually meet in the main game as well - From Sabrinas best friend, Lea, the ginger beauty and her very sexy mother to Jackie, MCs best friend, Rei, a very pretty girl from Japan that will have a big reveal in the end and Amelie, a girl you will meet in the university who didn't have an easy life ( I know, I like to make characters like that ).

Like I said above, the first day is already fully playable and will introduce all the characters to you. You will also hear more about Anna which can be interesting for people that already know the main game. I did my best to make sure that even if you never played My New Memories before, you will still get engrossed in the story. At least I hope I did, you guys will be the judge for that.

Okay, enough of the prequel, I of course also worked on Chapter 4 of the main game. With me not being able to really make any renders it's kinda difficult to write as much for it right now, but I made some very good progress. I'd say I have around half the length of Chapter 3 content written already with myself reworking and redoing some scenes already. For example, I had a lewd scene planned for the beginning with a different woman that I ended up changing to another. So you still get a lewd scene, it will just be with a different woman, which means it will actually be even better ( and funnier ). As soon as I have my assets back the release should not take longer than 2 or 3 weeks. I will let you guys know as soon as possible.

To end this very long post I'll give you guys some screenshots from the prequel which will also be featured on the Steam Page for it. The Steam Page should go live next week, if all things go according to plan. Please share any feedback, critcism or whatever is in your mind in the comments or in the steam forums. Positive, negative, neutral, feel free to post about it, especially regarding the price thing for the prequel!

notes.title: First little update of 2024...
notes.notes:
Hello there Steam people!

It has been a little over a month since the last news already and I hope you guys had an amazing start into the year 2024. There hasn't been any progress updates lately because... Well, there is not really a lot of progress happening. On the 15th of december, my lawyer send another letter to the state attorney, requesting to at least get the one crucial SSD back that I need. Sadly, the state attorney didn't respond yet and yesterday, my lawyer send me an email stating that chances are high they won't respond to these kind of requests anymore. He proposed a different idea to me, that I should make a list with files that I need and that he will make a request to hand out copies of those files.

This might be a higher chance than getting the SSD back before anything, because apparently it can take up to 6 months to just mirror the harddrives here. That doesn't include checking them for any incriminating content, which can take up to 6 months again. We are now 4 months into my equipment being seized and while I was able to get a new computer ( because I had high hopes that this month would be the month I at least get one of my ssds back that literally only contain my render files ), it doesn't change the fact that I'm still heavily crippled regarding work on My New Memories.

The files I send to my lawyer for request basically contain all characters. I also had to put an explanation into the email what these files are, what you need to open them and what exactly you see in those files once they are opened in the rendering program, DAZ3D. This is all so the law enforcement worker knows what he's dealing with and can check those files manually to make sure they dont contain anything illegal ( and it saves them time researching themselves how to open a .duf file ). I also suggested they put a link to the steam page and steam TOS into the request so they can be assured that the game doesn't contain anything that is against their Terms of Service etc.

This is all... A lot to take in personally. Being robbed of the one thing in my life that fullfilled me with joy ( working on this game ) is becoming harder and harder to bear. I don't want people to support me if I can't work on the game as I should. I don't want people to buy the game if I can't continue the story in an appropiate timeframe. I know that a lot of devs out there wouldn't care since they can just use this time for vacation, relaxing, while still taking peoples money ( especially on patreon, which I also use ). But I don't want that. I'm currently looking if I can pause the ability for the game to be bought on Steam starting in february and will only reactivate it once I received those files or my assets in general back. I will do the same on other platforms where people can support me. Don't worry, I can live of money I saved for a bit and I will also be able to pay my eventual legal fees once it comes to that point in time. I only had to pay my lawyer once in advance and the rest will be paid once this whole case is over - Which will then hopefully be when I'm fully back on working on the game again.

I'm gonna be honest people, I'm trying my best to stay positive but things are looking pretty bad for me, at least in my head. I know that patience is the key to this shit, especially since I personally can't change anything about it right now, but the possibility that this is going to take what... maybe 8 more months? Is killing me. I have a plan B which means I will try to recreate these characters as good as I can, but that is the absolute last resort I want to fall back to. It would feel awful to do this and it would probably break my heart and kill all the motivation I have left to work on My New Memories, because I know the real characters are still out there...But I should stop thinking in that direction. I'm putting all my hopes and efforts into this request my lawyer is making because there are cases out there where people got copies of the requested files. It was mainly for stuff like tax evasion, where they seized computers and the company needed those essential files to work on their stuff again. So fingers crossed this will work for me as well.

Still, I want to thank all of you people for your amazing support and positive comments I got under my last post. I'm always trying to be as transparent as possible and I can guarantee you that I'm not trying to fish for sympathy or anything. I just want to keep you guys updated on whatever is happening and since there is not that much to share, I usually resort to... Well, not saying anything. I will try to make these updates at least monthly, even when there arent really news.

I of course still continue to work on the story of Chapter 4 and I'd say I'm about 1/3th done with the full script. So It's not like I'm not doing anything, but writing is currently the only thing I can do. I expect that the script will be fully done this month and then... Well, you know what I will do in february. After that it's just a very painful waiting game, I guess. In the meantime, have a render of Bethany!

notes.title: Small update and a few answers to concerns/comments
notes.notes:
Hello there Steam people!

It has been a while again and I'm finally able to return with some news.

If you don't know what's going on, the very very short tl;dr is that my rendering equipment ( that contains all the character files that I can't recreate ) has been seized by the police and is currently being investigated because I'm getting framed for a crime I didn't commit ( crypto scam ).

I had a very long talk with my lawyer on monday, since he has access to the case file now, and from everything we could read there, it's looking good for me. The only "bad" thing is that this is going to take a bit. We don't know an estimate, since all the cases differe regarding that, but I basically adviced him to write to the state attorney every week and ask him if I can get two of my crucial external ssds ( that contain all my rendering data ) back, as I can't work without them. That is sadly all we can do, keep pondering them and then waiting till they respond. I will get my stuff back eventually, and there is a good chance that I can get those ssds back sooner, but it all depends on how their investigations go. I don't think the law enforcement system here has a lot of knowledge regarding 3d rendering and making an Adult Game in general, so that is something we might have to explain to a judge/state attorney as well, if they have questions regarding that. But the TL;DR is that things are looking good in my case and that it's, like I said, just a matter of time. It can be days, it can be weeks but sadly, it can also be months. Rest assured though that as soon as I get a notification that I can get my SSDS back, Chapter 4 release will be extremely fast ( since I'm already writing a lot of stuff ahead ).

I also want to answer a few comments and messages I received lately, mainly that I'm a scammer and don't care about Steam and you amazing people that bought the game. Those allegations are completely false, I deeply care for the Steam community and having a game on this platform was a dream I had for a very, very long time. I had quite a lot of success on steam and while the sales have drastically slowed down ( as expected with these games ), I never did this for the money. My game is below the average price of AVNS and even when I leave early access, all future updates and possible DLCS will ALWAYS BE FREE. If you buy the game you get the complete game, no matter how big the updates will be, I will never charge you again. I know that the long waiting, especially after the very exciting ending of chapter 3, is annoying and trust me, there is not a single person in the world that is currently more annoyed ( and actually emotionally hurt ) because of the current situation than me. Working on My New Memories has become my life, creating these stories filled me with joy that I never experienced before. Not being able to make renders with my favorite characters is actually affecting me emotionally to the point where I sometimes break down. Is that healthy? Probably not. Why do I tell you this? Because I want you to understand that I love my games and I love the Steam community.

There is not a community I care more or less for, it doesn't matter if it's on my Discord or other social media platforms. Yes, I use Patreon, but I started my Patreon page for my first game back in 2019, before My New Memories was even a thing. That game is completed now and the plan was to fully focus on My New Memories, but you know what happened then. Being at a crossroad like this basically destroyed all the planning I had and while it is "only" on hold for now ( until I get my stuff back ), it still is an emotional rollercoaster. I fully and one hundred percent understand if people either here or on other platforms don't want to support me anymore - and I know that this is more difficult on steam, since you already paid for the game. There is no "But" here, if I'm not able to work on my game and provide you with promised updates, you have all the right in the world to be angry and disappointed. But please don't accuse me of not caring about Steam just because of other platforms - Because that is simply no true.  It is out of my hand at the moment and I'm doing everything I can to get back on track. notes.notes:
Hey there amazing Steam people!

The release of Chapter 3 has been over two months ago and I think it's time to talk with you guys about my plans regarding Chapter 4 and of course, giving you a somewhat decent timeframe for the release.

First, I want to give out a huge thank you for everyone that played My New Memories so far. When Chapter 3 released we broke the all time concurrent player record we had before by a lot - 487 players! Seeing this made me happier than I ever thought it would, so again, thank you so much for playing My New Memories!

Chapter 3 has been a big emotional rollercoaster for a lot of players - From funny and cute to emotional and sad to very threatening and scary moments, this chapter had all of it. And I think the ending set a lot of minds at ease because the MC finally got all his memories back and of course, a certain other thing I'm not going to mention here ( in case you didn't play Chapter 3 yet! )

Chapter 4 will probably be the most wholesome and story wise important update, though. Now that a certain thing has finally happened, the way I can tell the story will become way easier. I'm personally not a huge fan to have a constant antagonist or something threatening your love interests in a game, I'm not really big into drama in general. I prefer wholesome, slice of life romance with some emotional and of course, a lot of lewd and cute moments. Think of the sauna event you had with Lina - I want to do more of those. An event that is not aimed to be lewd, but it still kinda is, with lots of deep conversations between the MC and a girl ( or girls, even ).

Chapter 4 will also Introduce three new characters, they have been mentioned in Chapter 3 but I feel like I can give you guys a better overview.

The first one is Karla. Here is a render of her:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40590713/259c86dec96b2191dfc105f5fda5decf1927991f.png
Karla is MC's stepmother. A few years after the divorce, Manny ( mcs father ) decided to date again and met Karla. She is more of a quiet person, but she loves the MC just as much as bethany does. Even though you won't call her Mom, she still feels connected to you. After Manny passed away it was very difficult for her to be alone, so the MC and Anna both helped her as much as they could. It wasn't easy, of course, since Sabrina and Jessica both really dislike her. Bethany, on the other hand, actually likes her and they both share a lot of things. Because of a certain incident that happened a few years ago you haven't seen her in a while, so meeting her again will be really emotional.

Karla and Manny(✞) have two daughters, Caroline and Emily. Here is a render of them ( Caroline is on the left, Emily on the right ).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40590713/b0f2504390af4858f9f9a9cc9876ccea7125637b.png
As you can see, they are twins. So they can relate pretty well between the MC and Sabrina. Sadly, Sabrina ( just like Jessica ) never showed any interest in getting to know their half-sisters, unlike the MC who stayed in contact with his father until he passed away. They were still young when Manny passed away, so the MC and Anna did their best to be there for them. He is their big brother after all, and he always helped them out when he could. Jessica and Sabrina both did their best to do the opposite - and then said something that hurt both of them a lot. Caroline, who has a very sunny and happy personality, comperable to Lina, doesn't hold any grudge though, at least if they apologize. Emily, who is more like Sophie, on the other hand, is still very hurt from what happened.

Once they will arrive there will certainly be some tension between the siblings. Sabrina ( if you are on her route ) already showed regret for her behavior, but Jessica is a whole different nut to crack...

Speaking of Jessica, don't worry too much regarding the end of Chapter 3 when it comes to her. The MC will have a longer talk with her where a lot of things will be spoken out that he held back over the years - mainly to not hurt her, but also to not open up old wounds. But sometimes you have to open up wounds in order for them to heal properly and the MC is not going to step back again when it comes to her. Too long has he been letting her have it her way and now is the time she finally comes to her senses. I think once this talk with her is done you will start to see her with different eyes as well - Just like she will do for herself.

Chapter 4 is all about healing and I think I said that a few times already. But once you start it, you will immediately know what I mean. It will pick up right where you left at the end of chapter 3 and this first day will consist of the night + the following day ( so you basically get half a day as "extra" content ). There are so many things the MC has to talk about with a certain person, so many emotions he will go through and so many wholesome things that will happen. I can tell you now that this event will be the most emotional ever in My New Memories. And it won't stop there, you still have to talk to Sarah as well, especially after what happened at the end of chapter 3. But like I said, it's about healing and I think it's finally time that the family can heal from all the terrible things that have happened before. It's the beginning of a new story arc after all, an arc that will be all about family ( and introducing new people to persons that didn't meet each other before, like Samantha and the rest of the family).

I will have more to share regarding the story of Chapter 4, but I think this is better for another post. For now, I'll leave you guys with a few more renders that will all appear ingame for Chapter 4. Maybe you can get a good guess what will happen there. I will do my best to release Chapter 4 this year and I'm super confident that I can do that. In the meantime, a big thanks again for everyone that played My New Memories so far and a very big thanks to all the amazing people that left a review - be it negative or positive. If you guys have any questions, don't hesitate to ask them here or on the official Discord!

I wasn't sure if many people would enjoy the direction the update is heading, but it looks like most of you were pretty happy. You made some great progress with Bethany and Yukiko and you even had a normal conversation with Jessica for once! Chapter III will continue this development, so you can be sure that everyone gets their fair share of love.

I also read your feedback regarding a character sheet and I can promise you that this one is coming - this year. I will upload this to steam as a "hot fix" update, so there won't be any special announcement for it. What this essentially will do is, you get the picture of a character in the menu ( while you are playing you can click on "Character sheets" ) and it will bring up another picture that tells you who this character is, what her relation to the MC is and a little bit about her personality ( including pet names ). I think this will help make sure that you don't forget the character names. 

I know that some of you also had some problems with differentiating between Lena and Lina - Since those names sound almost the same when you speak them in their english variants. When I was giving them those names I was more thinking how we say those names in German - very different. So showing you who Lina is ( Pebbles ) and who Lena is ( sister in law ) in a small character sheet will hopefully clear that up. For now I plan to do this for all the girls - This includes women that you only met once for now, like the Doctor you visited with Morgan ( if you are on her transgender route ). So the character sheet will hopefully help with that.

Now, let's talk a bit about Chapter III. The ending of Chapter II was rather cryptic, but if you read between the lines you probably noticed that Sarah seems to play a key part in this. If you decided to listen to her story, of course, and if you haven't - well, I advise you to replay the game because Chapter III will be kinda weird if you don't. Up to you, of course. You finally found out who was behind the accident in Chapter II - Or at least, he claims to be behind it. Chapter III will play around this news even more, leading to a closure on this part of the story. I think I already mentioned this, but Chapter III will close the first arc of My New Memories. This won't be the last one, of course, so you don't have to worry that the game will end anytime soon. Quite the opposite, actually.

I've also experimented with different hairstyles for the girls. You can see them in this news post, I attached them below the Halloween render. They won't be a permanent thing and you will most likely only see them for 1 or 2 renders - Think of it like a moment where Sophie gets out of the shower or Lena gets ready for training - Since they have long hair, they can either leave it open ( in Sophies case, since she always wears her ponytail ) or they can put their hair in ponytails ( like Yukiko and Lena ). I will experiment some more with those, just adding very little variety into this. The original hairstyles will stay, so you don't have to worry about that part.

Chapter III will also lean more into the decisions you can make. Most of them will evolve around "Do I want this character to be more than just x?" or not. If you say no, nothing will change in your relationship with them, if you say yes you get some extra content that will explore this part some more. Think of it like Bethany...When you had that glass of wine with her. It will be very interesting how that one will play out...And then there is also Lina and others that might want to get more out of the relationship they already have with the MC...

So you will get the full package again. More lewds, more wholesome moments and the big finale for the first story arc. I will make sure that you guys will be like "Whoa...That just happened" at the end, with (hopefully) a big smile and excitement for the next Chapter. I'll leave this news with the renders now. Don't forget to share your feedback/concerns etc in the steam forum!

I want to end this post with a huge thank you for everyone that gave me feedback on Chapter II. It really means a lot to me to hear from you guys if you enjoyed something, just like if you didn't enjoy something. I'll do my best that the wait for Chapter III won't be as long. I will make sure to make it up to you guys! Keep in mind, if you buy the game once you will get all future updates and everything extra FOR FREE, even if it takes a little longer.

Now with this out of the way, I want to give you guys some more infos regarding Chapter II and in which direction the game is heading, especially since I already worked a few things out. The first day of the update is fully planned out and I would say the writing is about 50% done, with the renders being 30% done. This day and the update in general will be massive - I expect it to be as big or even bigger than Chapter I was, since there are a lot of things I want to do.

If you didn't play the game yet or didn't finish Chapter I yet, I would avoid the rest of this paragraph since I will talk about some things that happened in the Chapter. As you may remember, at the end of Chapter II the MC got a call from Dr. Slatni, the doctor in the hospital, who told him that Anna is pregnant. This was the great surprise they wanted to announce on Christmas. After the MC gets this news a lot of memories will return and he will finally get all the hints that Anna gave him during his dreams. The first day of the update will mainly focus on that - and it will be very, very important. It's up to you if you want to tell your family about Annas pregnancy or not and the decision on that will lead to...Consequences that are not so pleasant. Let's just say it's better to be open and honest with your family, rather than being "selfish", since they rather would like to hear it from you than from the hospital. Especially someone like Lena will not take it kindly if you don't tell her yourself...

My plan for Chapter II is to basically create a bit of more "tense" moments again. While I still aim for a wholesome and very feels good game, I still think that a bit of tension can help with the overall story in general. For example, the MC will remember a certain thing he did regarding Sarahs father, which makes him question how far he would go to protect his family...And if it is the right thing to do in general ( spoiler: It always is.) There is also the situation with Jessica being the only one in the family that doesn't know about Lena and the MC, and who Yukiko really is, and no one really dared to tell her yet, so that is also something you will have to decide in Chapter II. Feel free to ask me any questions here or on the forums, I'll do my best to answer them ( this time for real ). And thank you for all the recent positive reviews, that means a lot!

notes.title: Progress Update #3 - Roadmap for 2022
notes.notes:
Hello there Steam people!

I feel like this has become sort of a habit now, but I want to apologize again for not updating you guys sooner. I'm extremely busy at the moment and also had to deal with some personal stuff. Still, that is not an apology and I promise to be more talkative here in the future.

First, I want to talk a bit about Chapter I and some issues that appeared right after the release, mainly the savegame stuff. I don't really know why this happened and I'm sorry ( god I'm saying this a lot ) that some of you guys had to restart the game because your savegames were not working. I'm going to do my best that this won't happen again with Chapter II and will go through some extended testing to make sure everything will work. And if issues like that happen again then I will provide a function so you can just jump directly to the new chapter.

Now, let's talk a bit more about the upcoming Chapter II. As you probably remembered, at the end of Chapter I the MC gets a call from Dr. Slatni, dropping a pretty important news for him and his family. Chapter II will start directly where you left off and will be a little different compared to the last Chapter. I think there is an easy way of describing the game so far: You had the prologue with some heavy dialogues and events that feature a more serious tone, then you had Chapter I which was more about the healing process and rekindling old relationships ( with some lewds ). Chapter II will be more like the prologue again, with heavier dialogues and more in depth decisions. Right at the beginning of Chapter II you will have to make a very important decision that will guide your way through the update. Make the "right" decision and you will get more wholesome events where the family supports each other again. Make the "wrong" decision and you will find out that some things can't be done alone. I'm not going to spoil more, but like I said it will be pretty important. I currently aim to release this update in early spring - My guess at the moment is April, but this might change. Keep in mind that Chapter II, just like Chapter I, will be a FREE update, just like every future update will be free if you bought the game. 

Now that you met all the girls that are part of the family it might be time to update the Steam screenshots and other things. It will be a longer progress because I have to see which images are fitting without spoiling too much of the story. I might also include some more lewd pictures now that we saw a few more girls naked in the game. So if you are interested in things like that, keep an eye out on the store page!

I also wanted to address and clarify a few things again that came up in reviews and comments. I know I basically do this all the time but I'm afraid there is no way around it.

The first thing is that the game is still in active development. The early access tag is there for a reason. This means the story is not completed yet - not even close. There is still a lot ( and I mean a lot ) of content coming - Story wise and in terms of lewds. I know that the current game doesn't feature that many lewds compared to others, but that is also not what I am aiming for. I always want to provide more of a story where the sexual content is an extra, not the main deciding factor. That's why I put the "warning" on the store page that there is a lot of reading involved. There are decisions in the game that will alter your game, but this is a Visual Novel, that means your "gameplay" is reading, no mini games or freeroam where you have to grind things.

The other thing is that this is still a game. Some things will never be as realistic as they are in real life - Which is fine, in my opinion, because that's what games are for, I think. I don't want to create a game where people have to face problems they might also face in real life - be it financially or with a person they love and care about. I want to make games where people get attached to characters and care for them, in a positive way. Where you don't have to fear that you might lose a character if you make a "wrong" decision. The same goes for the looks of some characters. I know that Bethany might not look old enough to be a grandmother or that Anna and the MC look old enough to be parents of 5 daughters. I wanted to create good and cute looking characters and didn't go for accuracy or realism again. What I want to say with all of this is that expecting realism is okay, but that this is still a game. I don't want to talk more about the looks of the characters - I did that so many times. It's fine if you don't agree with me setting the ages like that, but there are other ways of saying this than to attack me or my game personally.

That is all for now. Like I said in the beginning I'll do my best to update you guys some more - Maybe with a few more previews. In the meantime, have a few special renders I made in the last weeks!

Hello there people of the steam community!

Now that the game has been out for two months I think it's time to give you guys a little progress update on everything so far.

The good news is that I already finished the beta build for the first ingame day of the update. If you didn't read the other news yet, the first big update for My New Memories will be split in half. While the prologue was six ingame days, Chapter 1 part 1 will "only" be three ingame days. I have big plans for this first update. One thing I wanted to talk about is the lewd scenes, which will increase with Chapter 1. And they won't be dream sequences anymore, from this point on going forward you will experience "the real" stuff, no more flashbacks only. You will also make great progress with two of the characters that the MC already started a relationship with - If you want that, of course. It is totally optional if you want to go for Sabrina or Lena, but you will miss out on content if you don't!

I haven't fully decided yet if and how I want to publish the betas on steam. At the moment I will probably release the first beta for everyone here ( that wants to participate ) after the second beta has been completed. Just keep in mind that these betas will contain bugs and miss a few things ( for example, no achievements ). And it's advised that you make seperate savefiles for each beta release just in case things can break - It is a beta after all, not the full chapter!

Now I want to address a few other things that have been piling up again and that I already talked about in other news. Lately people have been attacking me and some of my players personally in steam reviews, calling out the looks of the characters(again) and insulting me on a level that is not really needed. Like I said in my other post last month, Steam has a very strict review rule of their games. So even if you disagree with the looks of the characters ( even though they are not sexualised at all ), Steam allowed the game to be posted here. Calling players the worst things in the world or mentioning that they all look 12 won't change the fact that this is just your personal opinion ( that doesn't represent the actual age of the girls ). Some of the early dialogues could give that thought that the girls are younger, but that is mainly because they all experienced a severe trauma with both of their parents being involved in a car accident. This can throw people back for a certain amount of time and you will quickly notice that they return to their old behaviour in Chapter 1 ( to represent their actual adult age ). The family in My New Memories is very, very close and certain things will get explained ( for example, why the girls are still living at home etc ). Now you can disagree with that, you can also say "Stop talking bullshit they aren't as old as you say they are", and it's totally fine if you think that. But that is not what is represented in the game or the story and the actual canon age. There are ZERO reasons to attack me or anyone else, especially in reviews. If you don't like the game that is totally fine too, if you played less than 2 hours you can even refund it if you want. Hey there you amazing people in the Steam community!

I think now that My New Memories has released on Steam for a few days, it's a good time to talk about my update plans and what you can expect in the coming weeks/months!

But first I want to thank each and everyone here on Steam that decided to buy my game! It means a lot!

I already started work on the first major update, also known as Chapter 1. If you decided to buy the game then all future chapters will be free, so you don't have to fear to ever pay again for this game. This also includes all the little things I'm planning to add over time. 

As some of you may have noticed I released a small update on the weekend which added the "Gallery" button. The Gallery lets you rewatch all the lewd scenes you unlocked so far - which are three at the moment, all with Anna. Once you start to lewd other characters they will be included there as well, of course.

Now, let's talk about the first update. At the moment I'm planning to release this update in two parts - Chapter 1 Part 1 and Chapter 1 Part 2. This means that updates should not take too long and should still deliver a decent amount of content for you to enjoy. The first update will pick up right where you left off after Lena dropped a very important hint at the end of your dream sequence with Anna. My plans are to keep a steady stream of updates going to keep you players entertained. I will also do my best to keep everyone updated on the current status of the update and game in general.

Chapter 1 will also amp up the lewd scenes you are going to see with certain characters. You can probably guess one of them already since she is a very direct person and doesn't want to wait til MC made up his mind regarding her. The other is more patient but MC will still make a decision if he wants to keep the romance going they so freshly started before the accident.

Another thing I want to discuss are certain concerns that some people brought up, some in a very normal and friendly way and others in a very hostile way (which ended up in community bans for them). It's about the canon age of the daughters. Since I already said that Olivia won't be lewded even though she is 18, I wanted to reassure everyone that ALL THE CHARACTERS ARE OF AGE IN THIS GAME. Steam checks games before you are allowed to publish them and I can guarantee you that the petite looking characters have fully developed feminine bodies. But since none of them are being sexualized at all at the moment ( they don't even wear skimpy clothes ) you should not worry about these things too much. Don't base your judgement just off screenshots you see. I will make sure that each character shows that they are mature enough and if you still don't feel comfortable with that then you should know that EVERY romance in the game is OPTIONAL. You can romance EVERYONE if you want to, but if you don't want to romance Sophie, Morgan or Yukiko then you don't have to. You won't get a game over or anything like that and they will still be in the game, just like they are right now with nothing sexual attached to them at all. That is something I just wanted to clear up in case you don't feel comfortable with those characters around. There is no reason to attack me or the players of this game with insults and if I see things like that, I will delete and issue community bans. Just keep it civil and if you have concerns, keep them civil as well.

Okay, with this out of the way I want to give you people a small preview of a new upcoming character you're going to meet in the first update. She is related to a certain girl you already met and she was also mentioned before. Tell me what you think of her looks if you want!
